document.abstract: (1.1) This practice specifies the film tension needed to transport 35-mm motion-picture film through a film-handling system operating under 0.9 m/s (180 ft/min) while minimizing conditions that contribute to film damage. (1.2) This practice also recommends methods for testing film tension.
